# ImPsychOut

> Online therapy with Laraib Fatima Ahmed, a clinical psychologist (MSc Clinical Psychology, Graduate Member of the British Psychological Society). Sessions are online over secure video for teens, young adults and adults. New clients can request a free 15-minute consultation.

## Key facts

- Practitioner: Laraib Fatima Ahmed, Clinical Psychologist
- Format: online video sessions, worldwide
- Who: teens (with a parent or guardian involved at first contact), young adults and adults
- Approaches: CBT, DBT, ACT, REBT, Positive Behaviour Management, Eidetic therapy
- Areas of focus: anxiety and panic, depression and low mood, OCD and intrusive thoughts, neurodiversity and autism, personality disorders, schizophrenia-spectrum, individual therapy, psychological assessment
- Training: MSc Clinical Psychology (Merit), BS (Hons) Psychology (Air University), Psychological First Aid (Johns Hopkins University), Good Clinical Practice (NIDA)
- Experience: Sit With It Therapy Hub, Autism Life Centres (UK), PAF Hospital Psychiatric Department
- Not an emergency service. People in immediate danger should contact local emergency services.

## How to get in touch

- Request a free consultation: the form at /#book (fields: name, email, optional phone, who the therapy is for, focus area, optional message, and a consent checkbox)
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/impsychout/
